Was bezeugt der Geist unserem Geist? Wie hilft Er uns beten, und wovor bewahrt uns das Wandeln im Geist?
Was ist die Frucht des Geistes? Wie viele Dinge nennt Paulus, und was sagt er über die, die Christus angehören?
Welche Gaben gibt der Geist, wem, und wozu? Was sagt Paulus über Zungenrede und Weissagung?
Was sollen wir dem Geist nicht antun? Als Ananias den Heiligen Geist belog, wen hat er nach Petrus belogen?
Was sagte Jesus über die Lästerung wider den Heiligen Geist? Lies es mit den Versen drumherum bei Markus: warum sagte Er es?
Für das Leben: Was wird der Vater nach Jesu Wort denen geben, die Ihn bitten? Womit sollen wir nach Paulus erfüllt werden?

title: The Name
opening_question: What is God's name, and what is the name by which we must be saved?
step_questions: What did God tell Moses to say when the people ask for His name? What did Jesus say before Abraham?
By which name does God say He was not known to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob? Read it next to the earlier verses that use the name.
What do these verses say about God's name: how it is to be treated, and how far it reaches?
What do the prophets say about forgetting the name and calling on it? Compare Joel with the verse that quotes him.
What name did Moses give Hoshea, and what name was Mary's son to be given?
What does Jesus say He did with the Father's name?
What do these verses say about the name given among men, and the name above every name?
Living it out: "whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved". What do these verses ask of us with the name: running to it, hallowing it, being baptized in it, doing all in it?

title: The Psalms: songs and prayers for every season
opening_question: The Psalms were Israel's songbook and prayer book, and Jesus prayed them on the cross. They praise, they weep, they confess, they ask "How long?" Read ten of them: what do they teach us to say to God, in joy and in trouble?
step_questions: What are the two ways in Psalm 1? Where does the blessed man find his delight, and what is he like?
Who is David's shepherd, and what does the shepherd do for him? Whom does Jesus call the good shepherd?
How long, O LORD? What does David ask in Psalm 13, and how does the psalm end?
What does David cry in Psalm 22, and what does he describe? Who prayed its first words from the cross?
What did David say when Nathan came to him? What does he ask God for in Psalm 51?
What does God know about David? Where can David go from God's presence, and what does darkness hide from Him?
What is God to us in trouble? What does Psalm 46 say when the earth is removed, and what are we told to do?
What does David tell his soul in Psalm 103? Which benefits does he name, and how far does God remove our sins?
How shall a young man cleanse his way? What does Psalm 119 call God's word?
Living it out: what did Jesus say the psalms speak of? How are we to sing them, and how does the book end?

es.title: Los Salmos: cantos y oraciones para cada tiempo
es.opening_question: Los Salmos eran el libro de cantos y de oración de Israel, y Jesús los oró en la cruz. Alaban, lloran, confiesan, preguntan "¿Hasta cuándo?" Lee diez de ellos: ¿qué nos enseñan a decirle a Dios, en la alegría y en la angustia?
step_questions: ¿Cuáles son los dos caminos del Salmo 1? ¿Dónde halla su delicia el varón bienaventurado, y a qué se parece?
¿Quién es el pastor de David, y qué hace el pastor por él? ¿A quién llama Jesús el buen pastor?
¿Hasta cuándo, Jehová? ¿Qué pide David en el Salmo 13, y cómo termina el salmo?
¿Qué clama David en el Salmo 22, y qué describe? ¿Quién oró sus primeras palabras desde la cruz?
¿Qué dijo David cuando Natán vino a él? ¿Qué le pide a Dios en el Salmo 51?
¿Qué sabe Dios de David? ¿Adónde puede ir David lejos de la presencia de Dios, y qué le esconden las tinieblas?
¿Qué es Dios para nosotros en la angustia? ¿Qué dice el Salmo 46 cuando la tierra es removida, y qué se nos dice que hagamos?
¿Qué le dice David a su alma en el Salmo 103? ¿Qué beneficios nombra, y cuán lejos aparta Dios nuestros pecados?
¿Con qué limpiará el joven su camino? ¿Cómo llama el Salmo 119 a la palabra de Dios?
Para vivirlo: ¿qué dijo Jesús que dicen de Él los salmos? ¿Cómo hemos de cantarlos, y cómo termina el libro?

de.title: Die Psalmen: Lieder und Gebete für jede Zeit
de.opening_question: Die Psalmen waren Israels Liederbuch und Gebetbuch, und Jesus betete sie am Kreuz. Sie loben, sie weinen, sie bekennen, sie fragen "Wie lange?" Lies zehn von ihnen: Was lehren sie uns, Gott zu sagen, in der Freude und in der Not?
step_questions: Welches sind die zwei Wege in Psalm 1? Woran hat der Gesegnete seine Lust, und wem gleicht er?
Wer ist Davids Hirte, und was tut der Hirte für ihn? Wen nennt Jesus den guten Hirten?
HERR, wie lange? Worum bittet David in Psalm 13, und wie endet der Psalm?
Was ruft David in Psalm 22, und was beschreibt er? Wer betete seine ersten Worte am Kreuz?
Was sagte David, als Nathan zu ihm kam? Worum bittet er Gott in Psalm 51?
Was weiß Gott von David? Wohin kann David vor Gottes Angesicht gehen, und was verbirgt die Finsternis vor Ihm?
Was ist Gott für uns in der Not? Was sagt Psalm 46, wenn die Welt unterginge, und was sollen wir tun?
Was sagt David seiner Seele in Psalm 103? Welche Wohltaten nennt er, und wie weit entfernt Gott unsere Sünden?
Wie wird ein Jüngling seinen Weg unsträflich gehen? Wie nennt Psalm 119 Gottes Wort?
Für das Leben: Wovon reden die Psalmen nach Jesu Wort? Wie sollen wir sie singen, und wie endet das Buch?

title: The rainbow: God's bow in the cloud
opening_question: Whose sign is the rainbow, what does God say it means, and where else does the Bible show it?
step_questions: Before any rainbow, what did God make first, and what did He divide it from?
With whom does God make this covenant, what does He set in the cloud, and for how long?
What does God compare to "the waters of Noah", and what does He say shall not depart?
Ezekiel saw "the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain". Whose glory was it, and what colours does he name?
What is round about the throne in heaven, and what is it like to look upon?
What was upon the head of the mighty angel, and what was he clothed with?
What is round about the LORD, and what comes out of His hand?
Who does Jesus say is "the light of the world", and what does the one who follows Him have?
Living it out: God says "my kindness shall not depart from thee". What do these verses say His faithfulness means for us?

title: The rapture: what does the Bible say?
opening_question: The word rapture is not in English Bibles. It comes from the Latin Bible's word for "caught up" in 1 Thessalonians 4:17. What does the Bible say about believers being caught up to meet the Lord, about Jesus coming again in the clouds, and about when it happens? Read every verse, also the ones Christians read in different ways, and let the text speak.
step_questions: Why did Paul write about "them which are asleep"? When the Lord descends from heaven, who rises first, who is caught up, to meet whom, and what are we to do with these words?
What mystery does Paul show? When are we changed, how fast, and what will our bodies be like?
What did Jesus promise His disciples before He went away? And when He was taken up, how did the two men in white apparel say He will come back?

What happens "Immediately after the tribulation of those days"? What appears in heaven, who sees the Son of man coming, and whom do His angels gather, with what sound? Where did Daniel see the Son of man come with the clouds?
How do Mark and Luke tell the same moment? From where are the elect gathered, and what are believers to do "when these things begin to come to pass"?
Who knows the day and hour? What happened in the days of Noe, who is taken and who is left, and what does Jesus tell us to do?
What did Paul say must come first, before "the day of Christ"? What do the verses say about wrath, and about being kept "from the hour of temptation"? Compare what Jesus prayed for His disciples.
Two more passages readers bring: the ten virgins, and the first resurrection. Who was ready, and who lives and reigns with Christ?
How does the day of the Lord come, and why need it not overtake believers "as a thief"? What is "that blessed hope", what does that hope do in us, and how does the Bible end?
Living it out: whatever the timing, what do these verses ask of us while we wait?

title: The wheat and the tares: who is gathered first?
opening_question: At the harvest the householder says: "Gather ye together first the tares … but gather the wheat into my barn." Who is gathered first, when, by whom, and what does Scripture say comes before that day?
step_questions: Who sowed the tares, why did the householder say not to gather them up yet, and what is gathered first at the harvest?
In Jesus' own explanation, who is the sower, what is the field, who are the reapers, and when is the harvest?
In the parable of the net and in John the Baptist's words, who is separated from whom, and where does each go?
In the days of Noah, whom did the flood take away? Then who "shall be taken" and who "left", and where else is the same Greek word for "taken" used?
Lot's wife, one taken and one left: when the disciples asked "Where, Lord?", what did Jesus answer? Whom do the angels gather in Matthew 24:31?
Who rises first, who is caught up, and to meet whom? What did Paul tell the Thessalonians not to be shaken by?
What must come first before that day, how does the man of sin come, and why do they who perish believe a lie?
What did Jesus say to do if anyone says Christ is in the desert or in the secret chambers? How will his coming be seen, and who reaps the harvest of the earth?
The other separation parable: whom does the King set on His right hand and on His left, and what did each one do?
Living it out: the servants were told "Let both grow together until the harvest". What do these verses ask of us toward judging others, and toward our own readiness?

title: Women in the Bible: what does the Bible say?
opening_question: What does the Bible say about women? Read it from the beginning: how God made the woman, the prophetesses and women of faith in Israel, the virtuous woman, Mary, the women who followed Jesus and saw Him risen, the women of the early church, what Paul writes about women in the churches with the verses around it, and what all are in Christ. Read every verse, also the ones that seem to point another way, and let the text speak.
step_questions: In whose image did God make man, male and female? Why did God make the woman, and what did Adam call her?

Who led the women of Israel in song, whom did the LORD send before Israel with Moses and Aaron, who judged Israel, to whom did the priest go to enquire of the LORD, and who published the word in Psalm 68?
What did Ruth promise Naomi, and what did the women of Bethlehem say when Ruth's son was born? What did Hannah pray, how did Sarah conceive, and what did Esther risk?
Women of faith from outside Israel and in the family line of Jesus: what did Rahab say and do, how did Abigail stop David, and which women does Matthew name?
Who can find a virtuous woman? What does she do with her hands, her mouth and her household? What adorning is of great price in the sight of God, and which women does Peter hold up as examples?
What did the angel tell Mary, what did she answer, what did Elisabeth say of her faith, and to whom did Jesus give His mother at the cross?
Which women travelled with Jesus and ministered to Him, which sister chose that good part, whose word brought a Samaritan city to believe, and what did Jesus call the woman He healed?
Who stood by the cross, who came to the sepulchre on the first day of the week, and to whom did the risen Jesus say "go to my brethren"?
Who prayed with the apostles before Pentecost, on whom did God say He would pour out His Spirit, and which women served the church in Acts and in Paul's letters?

What does Paul write about a woman who prays or prophesies, about silence in the churches, about teaching, and about what the aged women teach? Read every verse in full, with the verses around it, side by side.
What are all who are baptized into Christ, and what are husband and wife together?
Living it out: Paul says "ye are all one in Christ Jesus". What do these verses ask of men and women together, each with the gift they have been given?

title: The Word made flesh, the way, the truth, the light
opening_question: Who is the Word, and what does the text say about keeping His commandments?
step_questions: Who is the Word, and what became of Him?
Who else does the New Testament say made all things, and whose image is He?
What does Jesus say He is?
What did Jesus say about the law and the commandments?
How does John say we know that we know Him?
What do these verses say about faith, works and the law? Read Paul and James side by side, next to the verses above.
How does Revelation describe the saints, and who has right to the tree of life? Compare the translations of 22:14.
Living it out: Jesus said "If ye love me, keep my commandments". What new commandment does He give, and how will people know His disciples?
